caption: The video showcases a calm, murky lake surface viewed from above, where dead leaves and debris lie suspended beneath the water. Several thin reed blades protrude from the surface, including a tall near-vertical blade with a small brown node at the centre and a splayed cluster of blades in the lower-centre. A few short angled blades sit on the right, and a thin dark stroke marks the upper-left edge beside the channel logo. Throughout the excerpt this upper-left stroke lengthens downward, transforming from a short straight diagonal into a longer wavy, zigzag vertical mark before straightening again toward a diagonal. In the latter portion of the clip, faint concentric ripples emerge near the top-centre of the water. They expand outward as additional rings, while the cause of these surface disturbances remains outside the visible frame. The protruding reeds, the submerged leaves, and the overall framing hold essentially fixed positions, with no detectable camera translation or pan. Static text and logo overlays sit in the top-left and bottom-right corners, and Chinese location text marks the scene as a lake in New Taipei, Taiwan.
